messages:
Olivia Chen: FYI - zendesk #98765. Customer (redwood-corp) on free trial, promo code won't apply from our support console. Console shows 'Action failed (500)'. Backoffice shows grant job enqueued but never finishes. Need quick triage.
support-bot: Auto-log: Zendesk ticket 98765 created, initial support attempt 2025-08-23T14:12:01Z.
Samir Patel: I can reproduce in staging. Steps: Admin Console -> Customers -> redwood-corp -> Billing -> Apply promo -> code PROMO-TRIAL2025 -> click Grant -> spinner -> 'Action failed (500)'.
Samir Patel: Console issues POST /admin/credits/apply body {"account_id":"acct_0xABC","code":"PROMO-TRIAL2025"} header X-Request-Id: 0x65ab... Stack trace shows: grant_worker.go:132 ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "credit_grants_pkey"; transaction aborted.
Josh Reyes: Sounds like a race between console's synchronous grant and the backoffice async consumer which also inserts a grant record. If both try to insert same grant id we get a hard DB conflict and 500 bubbles up. We've seen similar with the tombstone replay last quarter.
Samir Patel: Quick repro: send the same grant request twice in ~100ms -> one returns 200, next returns 500. No idempotency header set by console.
Josh Reyes: Temporary workaround for support: run internal tool 'support-tools grant --account acct_0xABC --code PROMO-TRIAL2025 --force' which does an upsert and records audit. I'll paste safe steps to ticket.
Ria Gomez: I'll notify the customer that we'll manually apply the promo and follow up. Need confirmed amount and audit entry for the ticket. Can someone paste the ledger line format?
Olivia Chen: Please avoid direct SQL unless Eng signs off. We need a safe short-term change plus a production rollout plan.
Eng Oncall: Created INF-2243. Plan: require X-Idempotency-Key on /admin/credits/apply and change grant insert to upsert (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) so retries are safe. Add dedupe in consumer. Will canary the change in us-east-1 tonight and monitor grant.duplicate_conflict metric.
Josh Reyes: I'll push a hotfix to the support console in ~15m to attach an idempotency key per grant action. Also will update support-tools to include idempotency-key so manual grants are safe.
Samir Patel: After console hotfix, retested in staging: double-submit doesn't produce 500 anymore, second request returns 200 with "already_applied":true.
Eng Oncall: Adding instrumentation to emit metric and a one-off migration to backfill missing tombstones so the consumer won't try to reapply older jobs. Rolling out patch to canary now.
Ria Gomez: Done — manually applied credits via support-tools and added audit entry: "credit_grant id=manual-98765 account=acct_0xABC amount=500 source=support-tools user=ria_g". Customer notified and happy for now.
support-bot: Zendesk #98765 updated: manual credit applied, customer notified, status: pending-engineers.
Olivia Chen: Thanks team — please tag billing & security on the INF-2243 PR for review before broad rollout. Keep me posted on canary metrics.
